proposal.description: Causes are recorded only on the clock the episode opens. A cause that appears later in the same episode is never added to fault_reg.
proposal.reason: While the converter is running with OTP already recorded, a later latch_assert or window trip does not set its bit. fault_reg reads only the first cause instead of all the causes OR-accumulated over the episode.

proposal.description: While the converter runs, the UVLO bit follows the live debounced UVLO instead of being set and held
proposal.reason: Suppose uvlo_state pulses high and then drops while ss_active or run_active stays high (a Vin dip that recovers). The UVLO bit in fault_reg clears again, but fault_time still holds the start time the dip stamped.

proposal.description: The over-temperature and over-voltage trips are confused: an inferred analog OVP trip is also recorded as OTP
proposal.reason: While running, if latch_state goes high with latch_assert low, fault_reg reads OVP|OTP (10100) instead of OVP alone (10000), even though otp_state never asserted.

proposal.description: Every S_RUN window trip is also recorded as LATCH_ASSERT (OCP/SCP), as if each window trip were an OCP trip into the latch
proposal.reason: In S_RUN, a window_trip that never builds up enough strikes to raise latch_assert sets fault_reg to 01001 instead of 00001, so it reports a CPLD latch trip that did not happen.
